'''Denver Mile High Mayhem''' was a [[Premiere - Death Star II]] tournament held on 27 June 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., at Namaste Solar, 888 Federal Blvd, Denver, Colorado 80204.<ref name="details">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1503865725528572044/1507490250849517759 Denver Mile High Mayhem official details], Discord (techmo001, 22 May 2026).</ref> Four players each played four games.<ref name="details" /><ref name="final">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1503865725528572044/1520540162306605218 Denver Mile High Mayhem final standings], Discord (techmo001, 27 June 2026).</ref> Josh won by a differential of 16.<ref name="final" /> Prizes included a Clash of Sabers tournament foil and an official Ewok mug.<ref name="prizes">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1503865725528572044/1507490847229349989 Denver Mile High Mayhem prizes], Discord (techmo001, 22 May 2026).</ref>
